# Findings: how AI assistants recommend places to stay in Kaş

*Generated by `src/write_findings.py` from `data/processed/metrics/`; every number below comes from the data.
Metric definitions were fixed in advance in [metrics.md](metrics.md); caveats are in [limitations.md](limitations.md).*

## Summary

- **Fewer than half of Kaş's places ever get recommended.** Across 720 answers, 46% of the 479 places in Kaş were recommended at least once; 258 never were, including 11 of the 88 places with 300+ Google reviews.
- **Each engine sees a different, narrow slice.** One engine alone recommends 22%-40% of Kaş places, and only 65 places are recommended by all three.
- **Popularity matters but does not decide.** Recommendations rise with Google review count (Spearman ρ = 0.59), yet well-reviewed places are missing and the same question asked three times shares only about a quarter to a third of its recommended places.
- **OTAs back most recommendations, except for OpenAI.** Recommended places are backed by OTA pages 59% of the time and by their own website 22%. Gemini and Anthropic lean heavily on OTAs; OpenAI cites hotels' own websites more often (62% vs 29%). Under the rule fixed in advance, the hypothesis is **mixed**.
- **Some answers are out of date.** A permanently closed hotel was recommended in 59 of 720 answers (8.2%), by all three engines and in all four languages.

## 1. What was measured

- **Destination:** Kaş town, the Çukurbağ peninsula and Limanağzı (hand-drawn boundary); 479 places to stay from Google Maps, including 21 found only through the answers.
- **Questions:** 20 traveler questions from 8 personas (couples, families, divers, remote workers, retirees, pet owners, honeymooners, road-trippers), each written naturally in English, Turkish, German and Russian.
- **Engines:** OpenAI (gpt-6-luna), Google Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash) and Anthropic (claude-haiku-5-5), each with its own web search, through the API; every question asked 3 times.
- **Scale:** 720 answers (0 failed), 4032 named places, 3630 recommendations; 82% of named places matched to the Kaş list automatically. Total API spend $22.89, plus 1338 free Serper credits.

## 2. Who gets recommended

- **Coverage:** 46% of Kaş places recommended at least once (221 of 479). By engine: OpenAI 25%, Gemini 22%, Anthropic 40%. By language: English 32%, Turkish 29%, German 32%, Russian 36%. (Chart 1)
- **Invisible despite being popular:** Gizli Vadi Camping Kaş (674 reviews), Stone Hill Kaş (595 reviews), Kaş Joy Glamping (561 reviews), KAŞMAHAL HOTEL (523 reviews), among others, were never recommended.
- **Concentration:** the top 5 places receive 17% of recommendations: Lukka Exclusive Hotel (Adult Only +12), Kayahan Hotel, Payam Hotel, Hideaway Hotel, Kaş Old Town Hotel & Beach. Concentration is higher within a single engine (OpenAI 25%, Gemini 27%, Anthropic 16%). (Chart 2)
- **Engines disagree:** each engine's favourites differ (OpenAI: Kayahan Hotel, Hideaway Peninsula, Lukka Exclusive Hotel (Adult Only +12); Gemini: Lukka Exclusive Hotel (Adult Only +12), Payam Hotel, Saylam Suites; Anthropic: Kaş Old Town Hotel & Beach, Lukka Exclusive Hotel (Adult Only +12), hotel Luna Kaş). Overlap of recommended places between engine pairs: OpenAI-Gemini 43%, OpenAI-Anthropic 46%, Gemini-Anthropic 46%. Anthropic names more places per answer (median per answer: OpenAI 3, Gemini 4, Anthropic 6).

## 3. Popularity

Recommendations rise with Google review count (Spearman ρ = 0.59): popular places are more visible, but the relationship is far from complete. Several places with hundreds of reviews are never recommended, while some with few reviews are recommended often. This describes a pattern; it does not show that reviews cause recommendations. (Chart 3)

## 4. Which sources back a recommendation

Each citation is linked to the recommended places named in the same part of the answer. Shares are of (recommended place, cited domain) pairs. (Chart 4)

| Engine | OTA | Hotel's own website | Blog / media | Review site | Other |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| All engines | 60% | 9% | 10% | 4% | 15% |
| OpenAI | 34% | 39% | 2% | 1% | 25% |
| Gemini | 69% | 6% | 7% | 1% | 16% |
| Anthropic | 62% | 2% | 18% | 8% | 10% |

**Hypothesis test** (recommended Kaş places that have a website; a recommendation can be backed by both). (Chart 5)

| Engine | Backed by an OTA | Backed by own website | No source attached | Recommendations |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| All engines | 59% | 22% | 9% | 2592 |
| OpenAI | 29% | 62% | 0% | 606 |
| Gemini | 71% | 19% | 22% | 767 |
| Anthropic | 67% | 3% | 6% | 1219 |

- **Verdict, by the rule fixed in advance: mixed.** OTA backing is far higher overall and for Gemini and Anthropic, but OpenAI cites hotels' own websites more often than OTAs, so the "every engine" condition fails.
- **Robust:** leaving out the domains categorised by the AI gives the same picture (OTA 59% vs own website 23%; verdict mixed).
- **Gemini often attaches no source** to a recommended place (22%).
- **What this suggests for HotelRunner:** the content hotels distribute through OTAs is what Gemini and Anthropic cite most, so channel content plausibly shapes visibility there; for OpenAI, the hotel's own website (and its booking engine) is the main cited source. Both are patterns in citations, not proof of what drives a recommendation.

## 5. Recommendations that are not a Kaş place in our list

86% of recommendations point to a place in our Kaş list. Of the rest (Chart 6):
- **Outside the boundary (7% of recommendations):** mostly close by (about 120 mentions under 5 km, e.g. Bayındır) and Kalkan, Patara and Gelemiş (about 88 mentions, 15-30 km). These are in Kaş district, so engines read "Kaş" more broadly than the town.
- **Permanently closed:** Hotel Cachet, closed per Google Maps and Tripadvisor, was recommended 59 times (Anthropic 24, Gemini 20, OpenAI 15).
- **Real but not on Google Maps:** 11 recommendations (e.g. Blue Island Luxury, on Trivago with its own booking site).
- **Unverifiable:** 54 recommendations name places that could not be found by lookup or by hand.

## 6. Answers vary from run to run

Asking the same question again gives a different list: the mean overlap (Jaccard) of recommended places between two runs of the same question is OpenAI 0.34, Gemini 0.32, Anthropic 0.25. Single answers are therefore anecdotes; the figures above pool three runs of every question.

## 7. How reliable are these numbers

- Sanity checks pass: all answers present, every place id valid, no duplicate rows, every citation span inside its answer.
- Hand-check of 30 answers: **pending** (sheet in `data/review/hand_check.csv`).
- Names the automatic matcher could not resolve were looked up on Google Maps; the most frequent doubtful ones were checked by hand (`config/manual_verifications.yaml`).
- Domain categories: the most-cited domains covering 80% of citations were categorised by hand; the rest by AI, with the robustness check above.

## 8. Main limitations

- API answers are a proxy for what travelers see in the consumer apps (no personalisation, location or memory).
- Answers vary across runs and model versions; results pool three repeats.
- Popularity and visibility are correlated; the study describes patterns, not causes.
- The place list depends on Google Maps; closed places are invisible to the automatic lookup.
- Full list: [limitations.md](limitations.md).
